blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Alas Pilipinas team captain Bryan Bagunas embraced all the lessons from the Asian Games with his teammates as they finished their campaign in 13th place. Alas was initially scheduled for a final classification game on Saturday, but Kyrgyzstan opted not to play, handing the Philippines 13th place after a 25-0, 25-0, 25-0 win by forfeiture. Bagunas thanked all the people who supported the team after he revealed at the start of their campaign that the program is still facing the same problem of lack of support and inadequate allowances.
